column1: # ZAP rule configuration for tools/zap/run.sh (zap-baseline.py / zap-api-scan.py -c).
# IGNORE = accepted risk or false positive, and the reason MUST follow the name.
# FAIL breaks the run. A rule not listed stays at WARN (reported, never fails).
# Every IGNORE here is also explained in docs/security/dast-report.md.
# FAIL: passive rules that mean High-impact exposure if they ever fire. (Any High
# alert also fails the run; see run.sh.)
